title: Equipment Deferrals and the Share of an Operating Lines of Credit Advance
content:
A member whose installments on an equipment loan with the association — one of its Equipment & Vehicle Loans — are deferred may advance only part of what the Operating Lines of Credit line would otherwise make available.

## Rule

The figure is taken:

- **at 0.5 of itself** when the member holds an equipment loan in deferred status that has used two or more deferrals;
- **at 0.8 of itself** when the member holds an equipment loan in deferred status that has used fewer than two;
- **at the whole of itself** when the member holds no equipment loan in deferred status.

The loan's status and the number of deferrals it has used are read from the member's Equipment & Vehicle Loans records. The share acts on what remains of the lending limit once everything to be taken off it has been taken off, before the result is compared with the room left on the day's phone limit and rounded to cents.

## Judgement table

| Equipment loan in deferred status | Deferrals used on that loan | Share of the figure |
|---|---|---|
| Held | 2 or more | 0.5 |
| Held | 1 | 0.8 |
| Held | 0 | 0.8 |
| None (only active or paid-off equipment loans, or none at all) | — | Whole |

## Illustration (hypothetical figure of USD 50,000.00)

A member whose Irrigation System Loan is in deferred status after its second deferral may advance 0.5 of the figure, USD 25,000.00; after its first deferral, 0.8 of it, USD 40,000.00.
